SELECT fi.fund_code ,fi.fund_name ,fi.fund_short_name ,fi.security_type ,dst.security_type_name ,fi.security_status ,fi.market_code ,fi.currency_code ,fi.latest_nav ,fi.establishment_date ,fi.fund_manager_names ,fi.fund_administrator ,fi.fund_custodian ,fi.accumulated_nav ,fi.investment_style ,fi.trade_price ,fi.issue_scale ,fi.latest_scale ,fi.data_date FROM rrs_fundinfo fi INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = fi.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'fund' AND dst.is_deleted = 0
AND fi.is_deleted = 0 AND fi.security_status != 'D'
AND fi.fund_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fundCode}, '%')
AND fi.fund_short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fundShortName}, '%')
AND fi.security_type = #{securityType}
AND fi.fund_administrator LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fundAdministrator}, '%')
ORDER BY fi.fund_code ASC

SELECT DISTINCT fi.security_type ,dst.security_type_name FROM rrs_fundinfo fi INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = fi.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'fund' AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE fi.is_deleted = 0 AND fi.security_status != 'D' ORDER BY dst.sort_order ASC ,fi.security_type ASC

SELECT fi.* ,dst.security_type_name FROM rrs_fundinfo fi LEFT JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = fi.security_type AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE fi.fund_code = #{fundCode} AND fi.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT ips.id ,ips.target_pool_id ,ips.target_pool_name AS poolName ,ips.pool_type ,ips.entry_time FROM ip_pool_status_fund ips WHERE ips.fund_code = #{fundCode} AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND ips.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ips.entry_time DESC ,ips.id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT target_pool_id FROM ip_pool_status_fund WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT al.* ,fd.name AS flowName FROM ip_adjust_log_fund al LEFT JOIN wf_flow_definition fd ON fd.id = al.flow_id
AND al.fund_code = #{fundCode} AND al.is_deleted = 0
AND al.adjust_batch_no = #{adjustBatchNo}
AND al.audit_status NOT IN ('-1', '20', '21', '99')
ORDER BY al.submit_time DESC, al.id DESC
SELECT * FROM ip_adjust_step_fund WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ip_adjust_log_fund WHERE adjust_batch_no = #{adjustBatchNo} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ip_adjust_log_fund SET audit_status = #{auditStatus} ,audit_time = NOW() ,updt_time = NOW() WHERE adjust_batch_no = #{adjustBatchNo} AND is_deleted = 0 AND audit_status IN ('00', '11')
UPDATE ip_pool_status_fund SET is_deleted = 1 ,updt_time = NOW() WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND target_pool_id = #{targetPoolId} AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(entry_time, audit_time, crte_time) FROM ip_pool_status_fund WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND target_pool_id = #{targetPoolId} AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT target_pool_id AS id ,COUNT(DISTINCT fund_code) AS currentCount FROM ip_pool_status_fund WHERE audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY target_pool_id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fund_code) FROM ip_pool_status_fund WHERE target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND audit_status = '20' AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT pool_id ,relation_type ,relation_pool_id FROM ip_pool_relation WHERE is_deleted = 0
